This examples is to highlight the fact that pandas data frames
are more powerful than spreadsheets,
since we can use arbitrary labels for the rows.

is a convention for organizing datasets
that makes statistical calculations and visualizations easy to perform.
Just like a tidy workplace,
a tidy dataset makes it easy to find what you’re looking for.
A data frame is organized according to the
format if it has the following characteristics:
Each column contains the values for one variable.
Each row contains the values for one observation.
Each data cell contains a single value.

This specific organization of data into rows and columns
makes it easy to perform statistical calculations on arbitrary subsets of the data,
and allows us to create seaborn plots
by mapping column names to visual aspects of the plot,
as we saw many times in this section.
